scope: eSpeak NG 1.52.0 (released 12 December 2024; the latest GitHub release when rechecked on 25 October 2026) built from the official source tag as a private file-output-only build (no PCAudio, asynchronous mode or MBROLA; Sonic disabled with USE_LIBSONIC=OFF, so the pinned Sonic source that was fetched was not used and there is no Sonic rate boost). Fresh integrated native development-kit cases were repeated against the current source; consult the registered receipt for exact cases and recorded runtimes. This refresh does not broaden the documented operation or runtime-support scope. acceptance: Run tools/qualify_espeakng.py with an eSpeak NG 1.52.0 espeak-ng and its matching data. Require literal and file narration cases at the rate bounds, two fresh native syntheses with identical PCM for each, UTF-8 and multi-line scripts, hostile refreshed-hash rejections (changed words, rate, PCM, header, receipt), refusals of controls, phoneme escapes, markup, silent and oversize input, missing-runtime and wrong-version verification faults, a planted receipt-executable trap, strict-JSON and typed-claim rejections, a handoff into SoX conform and FLAC, and timeout/cancellation lifecycle. Register only after shared integration freezes.
